Class KonceptTreeBlockProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.asciidoctor.extension.BaseProcessor
org.asciidoctor.extension.BlockProcessor
network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptTreeBlockProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.asciidoctor.extension.Processor
@Name("koncept-tree") @Contexts(":listing") @ContentModel(":raw") public class KonceptTreeBlockProcessor extends org.asciidoctor.extension.BlockProcessor
AsciidoctorJ block processor that renders a [koncept-tree] delimited block as an indented list of Koncept chips — the print/HTML/e-mail projection of the live tree Komet draws in the assistant surface (IKE-Network/ike-issues#827, the static counterpart of #805).

Usage in AsciiDoc: 

[koncept-tree]
----
k:sctid=772222008[Medical devices]
  k:sctid=118956008[Microbiology device]
    k:MultiTargetRespiratoryTest[Multi-target respiratory NAA test]
----

Each line is an id-bearing k: token; leading-space indentation carries the parent/child edges (nearest ancestor with a strictly smaller indent — any consistent unit works). Two token forms are accepted, so the same block is portable across media:

  • Typed id — k:sctid=…, k:uuid=…, k:id=…, k:nid=… — the exact grammar the live renderer parses (KonceptTreeBlockRenderer in komet-claude-plugin), so a tree the assistant emits in Komet renders identically here. The identicon is resolved store-free: sctid via SnomedUuids.fromSnomed(String), uuid/id directly. A nid is a live-store native id with no static meaning, so it falls back to its authoring label.
  • Name key — k:HeartFailure[…] — a key into koncepts.yml, resolved exactly like the inline KonceptInlineMacro; this form additionally carries the glossary cross-reference and the component-kind sigil.

A line may also be a computed query directive instead of a literal k: token — leaves: Identifier (every leaf descendant, walked recursively), children: Identifier (direct children only), descendants: Identifier (every descendant at any depth, not including the identifier itself), or kindof: Identifier (the identifier itself plus every descendant — Tinkar's own "kind of" relation) — expanded, before token parsing, into the equivalent set of k:Identifier[] lines at the directive's own indent (so they nest exactly where a literal list of the same lines would have). Both are computed fresh from the broader relationship already in koncepts.yml (KonceptGraph) — no separate query data, just a graph walk over what's already there (IKE-Network/ike-issues#879): 

[koncept-tree]
----
k:Axioms[]
  leaves: Axioms
----

The hierarchy is drawn with indentation, not line art: box-drawing connectors (├─ └─ │) are exactly what breaks on copy-and-paste (wrong font, collapsed whitespace, a plain-text target), whereas a leading run of fixed-width non-breaking spaces survives. The indent is therefore emitted as literal U+00A0 characters in the text — not a CSS margin, which would vanish the instant a reader copies the tree into a plain-text e-mail — and each chip carries its concept identity in the identicon alt/link title, so a plain-text copy degrades to an indented outline of names-with-identity rather than to rubble.

Stage 1 (#827) renders the html5 family (which includes the CSS-PDF backends Prince/AH/WeasyPrint, all of which report backend=html5); docbook5 → FO and Prawn pdf render the raw tokens as a literal block for now and gain their own indented projection in stage 2.
